Cocaine worth millions replaced with flour in UK court

A cocaine shipment valued at £10.4 million has gone missing from a court in the United Kingdom and was allegedly replaced with flour. The discovery was made after a large drug haul was found at a major airport, with an attempt to hide evidence.
